title: Evaluate label, order, changed-question and coherence sensitivity
summary: Create controlled probes that expose whether a semantic family follows its declared meaning and how much ordinary call variation affects the comparison. Separate intended invariance from deliberate meaning changes, and report failures without treating cross-question agreement as ground-truth correctness.
in_scope: Repeated calls, option-order remapping and label/definition controls
out_of_scope: Applying another model paper’s failure rate to Matter
implementation: Prepare repeated identical requests to estimate within-snapshot variation before comparing altered renderings.
Generate option-order permutations, neutral-label substitutions and meaningful-name-to-definition swaps with explicit semantic remapping to original outcomes.
Add paired topic/matter/occurrence questions on examples whose correct answers differ, so a model repeating an old answer fails meaning sensitivity.
Run complementary and equivalent propositions in separate and bundled requests; preserve contradictions and do not multiply their probabilities.
Produce a probe manifest and per-family qualification impact report including raw receipts, independent labels and affected specification revisions.

acceptance.criterion: Order and label probes compare mapped semantic outcomes rather than raw option strings.
acceptance.verification: Use deliberately permuted fixture labels and verify the remapping against a known oracle.

acceptance.criterion: Changed-question tests detect an evaluator that always returns the original answer.
acceptance.verification: Use paired same-topic/different-matter and same-matter/new-occurrence cases with fixed expected differences.

acceptance.criterion: Observed inconsistency is reported relative to repeat variation and cannot become a joint probability.
acceptance.verification: Inspect complement/bundling output and test the composition boundary rejects unsupported probability products.

tests: A Noul and Choice about the same claim disagree.
A neutral label control changes spelling but not definition.
A missing state field causes rendering failure before a probe call.
risks: A label permutation without semantic remapping creates a false failure.
Agreement can be high while all answers are wrong.

reuse.application: Use distinct relation definitions to construct changed-meaning cases, not unqualified copied templates.
